title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
summary: The second of five sisters trades sharp remarks with a proud, rich man at a country ball, misjudges him, and slowly changes her mind while her mother schemes to marry the girls off.

title: Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus
author: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley
summary: A young scientist builds a living creature from dead body parts, abandons it in disgust, and is hunted across Europe and into the Arctic ice by the lonely being he made.

title: Moby Dick; Or, The Whale
author: Herman Melville
summary: A sailor signs onto a whaling ship whose one-legged captain is obsessed with killing the giant white whale that took his leg.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
summary: A girl follows a white rabbit with a pocket watch down a hole into a strange world with a grinning cat, a mad tea party, and a queen who shouts off with their heads.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
summary: Twelve short cases where a London consulting detective and his doctor friend solve crimes through close observation, including a red-headed league and a speckled band.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
summary: Told through diaries and letters, a solicitor visits a count in a Transylvanian castle, and a group of friends later fight the vampire after he moves to England.

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
summary: A boy finds a treasure map in a dead sailor's chest and sails to an island, where a charming one-legged cook turns out to lead a pirate mutiny.

title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
summary: An inventor travels far into the future and finds humanity split into gentle surface dwellers and pale creatures who live underground.

title: The War of the Worlds
author: H. G. Wells
summary: Cylinders land near London, Martians in tripod fighting machines burn the countryside with heat rays, and the invaders are finally killed by earthly germs.

title: Jane Eyre: An Autobiography
author: Charlotte Brontë
summary: An orphan survives a cruel school, becomes a governess at a gloomy manor, and falls for its master, who hides a secret in the attic.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
summary: On the Yorkshire moors, a foundling and the daughter of the house share a wild love, and after she marries another man he spends his life taking revenge on both families.

title: A Tale of Two Cities
author: Charles Dickens
summary: Set in London and Paris during the French Revolution, a dissolute lawyer who looks like another man takes his place at the guillotine.

title: Great Expectations
author: Charles Dickens
summary: A poor boy helps an escaped convict in a graveyard, later receives money from a secret benefactor, and visits a jilted old woman who still wears her wedding dress.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
summary: A beautiful young man stays young while his painted portrait ages and grows ugly with every cruel thing he does.

title: Metamorphosis
author: Franz Kafka
summary: A travelling salesman wakes up one morning transformed into a giant insect, and his family slowly turns against him.

title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
summary: Four sisters grow up in New England while their father is away at the Civil War; the tomboy of the family wants to be a writer.

title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
author: Mark Twain
summary: A mischievous boy on the Mississippi tricks his friends into whitewashing a fence, witnesses a murder in a graveyard, and gets lost in a cave.

title: Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
author: Mark Twain
summary: A boy fakes his own death and floats down the Mississippi on a raft with a man escaping slavery.

title: Peter Pan
author: J. M. Barrie
summary: A boy who never grows up teaches three children to fly to Neverland, where they meet lost boys, a fairy, and a pirate captain with a hook for a hand.

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
summary: A tornado carries a Kansas girl and her dog to a magic land, where she follows a yellow brick road with a scarecrow, a tin man, and a cowardly lion.

title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
summary: A spoiled orphan sent to her uncle's Yorkshire manor finds a locked, neglected garden and a sickly cousin hidden away in the house.

title: The Jungle Book
author: Rudyard Kipling
summary: Stories of a boy raised by wolves in the Indian jungle, taught by a bear and a panther, and threatened by a tiger, along with a mongoose who fights cobras.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
author: Alexandre Dumas
summary: A young sailor is falsely imprisoned in an island fortress, escapes after years with a fellow prisoner's secret treasure, and returns rich to punish the men who betrayed him.

title: Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea
author: Jules Verne
summary: A professor hunting a sea monster is captured by a mysterious captain who sails the oceans in an electric submarine.

title: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
summary: A precise English gentleman bets his fortune that he can travel around the globe in eighty days, with his French valet and a detective who thinks he robbed a bank.

title: The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
summary: A London lawyer investigates the link between a respected doctor and a violent little man, and learns they are the same person, split by a potion.

title: Heart of Darkness
author: Joseph Conrad
summary: A sailor travels up an African river to find an ivory trader who has set himself up as a god among the people there.

title: The Call of the Wild
author: Jack London
summary: A big pet dog is stolen from a California home, sold as a sled dog in the Yukon gold rush, and slowly returns to the wild.

title: Anne of Green Gables
author: L. M. Montgomery
summary: An elderly brother and sister ask for an orphan boy to help on their farm and get a talkative red-haired girl instead.

title: The Invisible Man
author: H. G. Wells
summary: A bandaged stranger arrives at a village inn; he is a scientist who made himself invisible and cannot reverse it.

title: The Island of Doctor Moreau
author: H. G. Wells
summary: A shipwrecked man lands on an island where a scientist surgically turns animals into human-like creatures.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
summary: A detective investigates a family curse after an heir dies on the moor with the footprints of a gigantic hound nearby.

title: The Wind in the Willows
author: Kenneth Grahame
summary: A mole, a water rat, a badger, and a reckless toad obsessed with motor cars have adventures along an English river.

title: Through the Looking-Glass
author: Lewis Carroll
summary: A girl climbs through a mirror into a world laid out like a chessboard and meets twins, a talking egg on a wall, and red and white queens.

title: Black Beauty
author: Anna Sewell
summary: A horse tells his own life story, from a happy country childhood to hard work as a London cab horse.

title: Emma
author: Jane Austen
summary: A rich, clever young woman meddles in her friends' love lives and misreads almost every match she tries to make.

title: A Christmas Carol
author: Charles Dickens
summary: A miserly old man is visited on Christmas Eve by the ghost of his business partner and three spirits who show him his past, present, and future.

title: Grimms' Fairy Tales
author: Jacob Grimm and Wilhelm Grimm
summary: A collection of German folk tales, including children left in the woods who find a witch's candy house and a girl who lets down her long hair from a tower.

title: The Life and Adventures of Robinson Crusoe
author: Daniel Defoe
summary: A shipwrecked sailor survives alone for years on a remote island, builds a home, and eventually finds a footprint in the sand.

title: Gulliver's Travels
author: Jonathan Swift
summary: A ship's surgeon wakes up tied down by tiny people, later visits a land of giants, a flying island, and a country ruled by wise horses.

title: The Turn of the Screw
author: Henry James
summary: A governess at a country house becomes convinced that the two children in her care are being visited by the ghosts of former servants.

title: The Yellow Wallpaper
author: Charlotte Perkins Gilman
summary: A woman confined to a rented room for a rest cure becomes fixated on the pattern of its yellow wallpaper and the woman she sees behind it.
